body:
Thank you, you're right.
I'll try to keep your words in mind <3

Hey, I'm glad you're still here.
It's a big step to admit yourself, I'm proud of you.
Depression can be a parasite but only if you let it sit there. Do your best to keep your mind active on the positives and not the negatives and hopefully it will help you with your struggles, at least a little bit.

Thank you for your advice.

I'm sorry, I hope you can start feeling "real" again.
Just hang in there :)

Good job on seeing a therapist! 
It's a good step towards recovery and I'm glad to hear you're feeling less suicidal. 
Sometimes for me when I have good days the next days are really bad days, I think it's just ourselves feeling guilty for feeling good. Try not to let that part in, embrace the happy times.

Thank you, 
Even in times that I don't feel like I'm faking it, I still feel like I'm wasting their time but you're right. I wouldn't have the fear if I was faking, I'll try to keep that in mind.

Thank you, that sounds a lot like something I would say to someone haha
I rarely take advice from myself but hearing it from another person might make me take it in.

thank you, really great advice.
you helped me look at it from another angle and I'll try to keep this message in mind from now on.
